paragraphs: This picture shows how the Jeevan Ki Jyoti lessons and other tools described in this book fit within a Four Fields ministry strategy.

sections.title: Vision:
paragraphs: Healthy disciples and churches among every people and place.
What is your place in God’s vision?

items.text: – through a simple and consistent 3 Thirds process which is part of every lesson.

items.lead: The biblical gospel is clearly communicated
items.text: – following the hand gospel, every lesson shares parts of the gospel in a simple way.

items.lead: The Bible is always the foundation
items.text: – every lesson encourages reading the bible directly. This creates healthier disciples and churches.
– this is now part of the lesson process for all believers. Healthy churches use the 3 Thirds process and teach God’s word.

– the lessons and process prepare new leaders for “foundations” and other leadership trainings. The lessons are based on the same stories, and the 4 sword questions are used in every discipleship lesson.
– many different trainings are now included in the lesson. You can simply teach the lessons rather than planning many different trainings.
